# lucide_icons_flutter (base font only)

`lib/lucide_icons.dart` and `assets/lucide.ttf` copied unchanged from lucide_icons_flutter 4.0.2 on
pub.dev. The `Lucide100` to `Lucide600` weight fonts and their classes are left out: the app uses
only `LucideIcons`, and Flutter bundles every font a package declares, used or not.

To upgrade: copy those two files from the new version (and LICENSE), bump the version in
pubspec.yaml and the constraint in client/pubspec.yaml.
